### Fixed

- (app) [Offer the GitHub tabs only with a GitHub login on the 0.244 line](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2763) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On portals without a GitHub login, a component's page no longer shows the GitHub Actions and Pull Requests tabs, which only opened a `Login Required: GitHub` dialog that could never succeed.
